title.purpose: The Axe Shaper brand wordmark only.

body.purpose: Panel copy, template names, modal text, form labels.

label.purpose: Uppercase panel section headings and form labels.

mono.purpose: Any physical or numeric readout: zoom %, scale bar, coordinates.

marketing-display.purpose: Public-page thesis statements only; technical sans at physical scale.

shadows.name: shadow-lg
shadows.purpose: The only shadow token; used exclusively on floating/undocked surfaces (canvas toolbar, calibration card) per the Floating Glass Rule.

shadows.name: modal-shadow
shadows.purpose: Heavier one-off shadow for modals, the topmost floating layer.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default transition for buttons, tabs, template cards, focus states.

motion.name: settle-plan
motion.purpose: The one authored public-site motion: the real plan settles onto the bench.

breakpoints.name: editor-fixed
breakpoints.purpose: The editor remains a fixed 320px / 1fr / 300px desktop tool.

breakpoints.name: marketing-mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Public flows and actions become single-column.

components.name: Button — Default
components.description: The neutral base every other button variant builds on; used for toolbar actions like Undo/Redo/Open/Reset.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 14px; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--panel-border); background: var(--bg-tertiary); color: var(--text-primary); cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--bg-hover); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); } .ds-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Button — Primary
components.description: The active state of a segmented toggle (MM/IN, Vertical/Horizontal), not a standalone CTA.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 14px; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #3b82f6; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2563eb, #1d4ed8); color: #fff; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1d4ed8, #1e40af); }

components.name: Button — Accent (Save)
components.description: Reserved for the header's Save action — the only green button in the app.
components.css: .ds-btn-accent { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 14px; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--accent-green); background: linear-gradient(135deg, #059669, #047857); color: #fff; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-accent:hover { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #047857, #065f46); }

components.name: Card — Panel Section
components.description: Standard docked-panel card: flat, bordered, no shadow.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--bg-tertiary); border: 1px solid var(--panel-border); border-radius: 10px; padding: 14px; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: var(--text-secondary); margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-card-body { font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--text-primary); }

components.name: Card — Template (selectable)
components.description: A selectable list card; gold border + tint marks the active template, the same gold language as the active sidebar tab.
components.html:
S-Style Standardreference

Double cutaway with sweeping horns and waist contours.
components.css: .ds-template-card { padding: 12px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--bg-primary); border: 1px solid var(--panel-border); margin-bottom: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s ease; } .ds-template-card--active { background: rgba(209, 165, 61, 0.12); border-color: var(--accent-gold); } .ds-template-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-template-name { font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--text-primary); } .ds-template-tag { font-size: 0.7rem; color: var(--text-muted); background: var(--bg-tertiary); padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; } .ds-template-desc { font-size: 0.78rem; color: var(--text-secondary); margin: 0; }

components.name: Input — Text Field
components.description: Reads as an inset well (one tone darker than its panel) with a blue focus border.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 8px 12px; background: var(--bg-primary); border: 1px solid var(--panel-border); border-radius: 6px; color: var(--text-primary); font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--accent-blue); }

components.name: Navigation — Sidebar Tabs
components.description: Equal-width tab row; active tab switches to gold text + underline + faint tint.
components.html:
Body
Hardware
Layers
Guide
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--panel-border); background: rgba(0,0,0,0.2); } .ds-tab { flex: 1; min-width: 0; padding: 12px 4px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; text-align: center; color: var(--text-muted); cursor: pointer; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; transition: all 0.15s ease; } .ds-tab--active { color: var(--accent-gold); border-bottom-color: var(--accent-gold); background: rgba(209, 165, 61, 0.05); }

components.name: Toolbar — Floating Canvas Toolbar
components.description: Signature floating control: the one surface allowed a full pill radius, with glass blur + shadow per the Floating Glass Rule.
components.css: .ds-toolbar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 12px; background: var(--panel-bg); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border: 1px solid var(--panel-border); border-radius: 30px; box-shadow: 0 10px 25px -5px rgba(0,0,0,0.5), 0 8px 10px -6px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); } .ds-toolbar-btn { padding: 5px 10px; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--panel-border); background: var(--bg-tertiary); color: var(--text-primary); cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-toolbar-zoom { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--text-secondary); min-width: 50px; text-align: center; }

components.name: Button — Marketing Primary
components.description: High-contrast public conversion action; contrast rather than a new accent color.
components.css: .ds-marketing-cta { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:44px; padding:10px 16px; border:1px solid var(--text-primary); border-radius:6px; background:var(--text-primary); color:var(--bg-primary); font-family:'Inter',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:.86rem; font-weight:650; text-decoration:none; transition:transform 160ms ease-out,background 160ms ease-out; } .ds-marketing-cta:hover { transform:translateY(-1px); background:#fff; } .ds-marketing-cta:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent-blue); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Brand Mark — Split Guitar/Axe
components.description: Transparent identity mark, simplified at chrome scale and textured at feature scale.
components.css: .ds-brand { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; color:var(--text-primary); font-family:'Inter',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:1rem; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-.025em; } .ds-brand img { width:28px; height:28px; object-fit:contain; }

narrative.overview: Axe Shaper reads like a workshop after hours: a dark room, one warm antique-gold work-light, and precision instruments laid out on dark glass. The chrome around the canvas is quiet on purpose — near-black slate panels, hairline borders, no ornament — so the only thing asking for attention is the gold accent marking whatever is currently live: the active tab, the selected template, a locked anchor. The mood is precise, quiet, and technical, closer to a well-made measuring tool than a creative app; it should never read as playful or as generic SaaS chrome.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black navy-slate surfaces (#0f1117 → #282d3f) with a single warm antique-gold accent (#d1a53d) reserved for "this is active/current/locked." A cooler sky-blue and emerald green carry secondary, purpose-specific signals (focus/info, save/confirm) rather than competing for the same attention gold owns.
Flat, bordered structural chrome; floating overlays get glass treatment. See the Floating Glass Rule.
JetBrains Mono for every physical/numeric readout (zoom %, scale bar, coordinates), Inter for everything else.
Tactile, confident controls: buttons read as solid and clickable, sized for a tool used for long sessions, not a marketing surface.
Public surfaces open the dark bench around one bright, physical artifact: the app’s own printable plan. Paper is proof and content, never ambient decoration.
The split guitar/axe mark is the recognizable signature: simplified at chrome scale and materially textured when it has enough room to read.

rules.name: The Gold Is Truth Rule
rules.body: The antique-gold accent always means "this is the current, active, or locked one." It is never used for a button that isn't the active state of a toggle, never for decoration.

rules.name: The Mono-Means-Measured Rule
rules.body: If a piece of text states a physical quantity the user could act on with a ruler or a router, it is set in JetBrains Mono. Everything else — labels, copy, names — is Inter.

rules.name: The Floating Glass Rule
rules.body: Blur and shadow are reserved for elements that float free of the layout's edges — toolbars, calibration cards, modals. Anything docked to a grid edge (header, sidebar, inspector) stays flat with a border only, regardless of whether it happens to sit visually over the canvas.

rules.name: The Toolbar Pill Rule
rules.body: The bottom-centered canvas toolbar is the one element allowed a full pill radius; every other container uses the sm/md radius scale. A second pill-shaped surface anywhere else would read as a second toolbar.

dos: Do reserve the antique-gold accent exclusively for "this is the active/current/locked one" — never as a decorative accent.
Do keep docked structural chrome (header, sidebar, inspector) flat — border only, no shadow or blur.
Do set any physical/numeric readout in JetBrains Mono.
Do size lucide icons explicitly per context: 15px inside .btn-sm, 16–18px in headers and modals, 20px for the brand mark.
Do use the app's own exported drawing when a public surface needs visual proof.
Do use credited documentary workshop photography to show the handoff from plan to wood.
donts: Don't add a CSS background pattern to the canvas container to imply a grid — it won't scale with zoom and will misrepresent millimetres; the real grid is drawn on the canvas itself.
Don't give purple a second job — it's reserved for the live bridge/neck hardware preview overlay on canvas, nowhere else.
Don't introduce a new border token; --panel-border is the established hairline everywhere.
Don't style Lucide icons with Tailwind classes; this project has no Tailwind installed.
Don't use plan paper as a generic light section background; it denotes a real work surface.
Don't present the composite marketing illustration as an actual product screenshot; reserve it for social-preview artwork.
